title: JMS pool health configuration (scoped fragment)
description: Scoped fragment for the four JMS pool health fields. This is not a complete JMS pool validator: it defines only health_timeout_ms, health_failure_threshold, health_broker_probe_mode, and health_check_interval_ms. Every other pool property (brokers, max_bridges, start/reconnect timings, cache directory, retry policy) keeps its runtime validation in JmsPoolConfig::validate(), and additional properties are permitted here by design.

health_timeout_ms.description: Liveness deadline for one JMS health RPC, in milliseconds, stored as a u64.

health_failure_threshold.description: Consecutive failed liveness probes required before the bridge restarts, stored as a u32.

health_broker_probe_mode.description: Broker diagnostic strategy for health checks: reuse one provider probe path or skip broker I/O.

health_check_interval_ms.description: Delay between health liveness probes, in milliseconds, stored as a u64.
